gate.run: $line = 'Live page: https://anyorder.suitz.xyz/ (the landing page; the app needs a local chain, see Quickstart)'; $script:ok = $true; function Get-Heads($lines) { $inFence = $false; foreach ($l in $lines) { if ($l -match '^\x60{3}') { $inFence = -not $inFence } elseif (-not $inFence -and $l -cmatch '^#{1,2} ') { $l } } }; function Test-Live($name, $lines, $from, $to, $whole) { $a = [array]::IndexOf($lines, $from); $b = [array]::IndexOf($lines, $to); $hits = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { if (($whole -and $lines[$i] -ceq $line) -or ((-not $whole) -and $lines[$i].Contains($line))) { $i } }); $urls = @($lines | Where-Object { $_.Contains('anyorder.suitz.xyz') }).Count; if ($a -lt 0 -or $b -lt 0 -or $hits.Count -ne 1 -or $hits[0] -le $a -or $hits[0] -ge $b -or $urls -ne 1) { "LIVE PAGE LINE: FAIL in $name (line hits $($hits.Count), domain mentions $urls)"; $script:ok = $false } }; $readme = @(Get-Content README.md -Encoding UTF8); $sub = @(Get-Content SUBMISSION.md -Encoding UTF8); $draft = @(Get-Content docs/gates/submission-draft.md -Encoding UTF8); $wantR = @('# AnyOrder','## Demo','## What it does','## Quickstart','## Built at Fe Builders Challenge 2026','## Contract addresses','## How it works','## Security notes','## Build & test','## Deploy','## The problem','## Approach','## Fe highlight','## Architecture','## Limitations','## Declaration','## Team','## Roadmap','## License'); $wantS = @('# AnyOrder','## The problem','## Approach','## Fe highlight','## Architecture','## Build and test','## Demo','## Limitations','## Declaration','## Team','## License'); if (((@(Get-Heads $readme)) -join '|') -cne ($wantR -join '|') -or $readme[0] -cne '<!-- readme-schema: R2-contract-protocol v1 + event-overlay -->') { 'README SCHEMA: FAIL'; $script:ok = $false }; if (((@(Get-Heads $sub)) -join '|') -cne ($wantS -join '|') -or @($sub -cmatch '^\*\*Pitch:\*\* ').Count -ne 1) { 'SUBMISSION SCHEMA: FAIL'; $script:ok = $false }; Test-Live 'README.md' $readme '## Demo' '## What it does' $true; Test-Live 'SUBMISSION.md' $sub '## Demo' '## Limitations' $true; Test-Live 'docs/gates/submission-draft.md' $draft '## Demo or reproducible example ("A short demo: a video, screenshots, or a reproducible CLI example")' '## Declaration ("A declaration of pre-existing work, reused code, and AI assistance")' $false; if ($script:ok) { 'LIVE PAGE: OK' } else { 'LIVE PAGE: FAIL' }
